newsitem.title: USA: ComEd Byron, Ill. nuke boosting power.
newsitem.headline: ComEd Byron, Ill. nuke boosting power.

text.p: Commonwealth Edison Co (ComEd) said its 1,105 megawatt Byron nuclear power unit 2 was boosting power and was expected to reach 50 percent of capacity Monday as it comes back from a maintenance outage.
"It was at 22 percent this morning, it should reach 50 percent later today," spokesman Gary Wald said Monday, adding it "should be at 100 percent later this week."
The Byron, Ill unit was shut Aug 8 for scheduled refueling and maintenance, and resumed electricity production on Friday, Sept 4, Wald said.

The Byron nuclear unit 1 was operating at near-normal levels of above 90 percent of capacity as of early Monday after reducing power to about 75 percent of capacity over the weekend for a turbine surveillance test, Wald said.
ComEd is a subsidiary of Unicom Corp.
